title: Sum of Sine Waves (Fourier Series Concept)
full_prompt: Write a complete Manim script using the ManimGL/Manim Community framework that visualizes the summation of multiple sine waves to build a complex wave. First, create a single pure sine wave on a set of coordinate axes. Add a brace indicating the period of this wave with the label '220 cycles / sec.' and label the axes 'Air pressure' and 'Time'. Second, transition this single wave into a stack of four smaller axes aligned vertically on the right side of the screen. Each of these smaller axes should display a different harmonic frequency wave (ratios 1, 6/5, 3/2, and 21/12 relative to the base frequency), colored with a gradient from BLUE to YELLOW, and labeled with their respective frequencies in Hz (220 Hz, 264 Hz, 330 Hz, 385 Hz). Finally, introduce a larger top axes spanning the upper portion of the screen, preparing to display the combined sum of these individual waves.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Use of `i2gp` in ManimCE without translating to `input_to_graph_point`
common_failure_modes.note: ManimGL uses `axes.i2gp(x, graph)` while ManimCE uses `axes.input_to_graph_point(x, graph)`.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Use of `ShowCreation` instead of `Create` in ManimCE
common_failure_modes.note: ManimGL's `ShowCreation` must be mapped to `Create` if running on ManimCE.
Using `set_submobject_colors_by_gradient` which is specific to ManimGL; in ManimCE, `set_color_by_gradient` should be used.
